name: Kuzuryuu Suzuka
source:
8th head of Kuzuryuu group and Kotaro's master.

After her parents' tragic death she became new leader of Kuzuryuu group. Due to this fact she is feared by her fellow schoolmates, but she also treats them distantly because of her position. Raised in household full of chivalry, she is serious, kind and honorable.
